title: Process rule: search_knowledge BEFORE reading flat strategy docs
summary: When asked about product positioning, competitive analysis, naming, or any strategic topic — call search_knowledge FIRST, always. The graph KB is the source of truth; flat files (competitive-analysis-2026-06.md, D1, D2, scratch/competitive/*) are snapshots written at a point in time and may be stale. The KB will surface notes like note-mq8a2gyd0ga (ZONOID ratified) that immediately reveal when a flat file is outdated. Caught: 2026-06-10 session where "what's our positioning?" was answered using Darwin-era flat file despite the graph having the correct ZONOID ratification note. The right flow: search_knowledge("product name positioning") → see current notes → if they contradict flat files, say so and use the notes, not the files.
